Subject: Bake-off framing & scope — HealthBridge follow-up

Jordan — thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our end and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum before procurement gets involved.

Key pain points you shared:
- Latency spikes on large document summaries (~>5s tail latency) causing poor UX for clinicians.
- Costs for batch embedding/semantic search rising as your index grows (billing unpredictability).
- Auditability & redaction requirements for PHI in logs and KV caches.

Goals we agreed on:
1) Reduce 95th percentile generation latency below 2s for short summaries (<=512 tokens) for demo traffic.
2) Demonstrate a pathway to reduce per-query embed cost via caching/quantization without degrading accuracy for clinical intent.
3) Validate compliance surface: KMS integration, audit log retention, and retentions rules.

Proposed bake-off scope (high level):
- Smoke tests: latency/throughput matrix across 3 model variants (open LLM, quantized variant, and Redwood-verified low-cost variant).
- Quality checks: 50-sample prompt set (you shared a subset in call) scored on clinical-precision and hallucination risk.
- Security checklist: SOC2 scope questions + KMS proof-of-concept (no production keys in POC).

Attachments: RBW_bakeoff_deck_v1.pdf (attached) with proposed matrices.

Asks / proposed timeline:
1) You to confirm the 50-sample prompt list (or share the full 200-row CSV) — ideally by EOD Thursday.
2) We'll provision a dedicated POC queue and run smoke tests next week (Dec 21–22).
3) Internal: Camila to own test execution; Marissa to validate quality metrics and reporting.

If that all looks good I’ll schedule the smoke-test kickoff and share the test matrix (sheet + runbook).

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

—
Markus Klein

Hi Jordan — adding a short test plan and pricing ballpark to help procurement.

Proposed smoke-test matrix (summary):
- Variant A (baseline open model): 100 requests, 4 concurrent clients — measure P50/P95/P99 latency + token cost.
- Variant B (quantized): same traffic pattern — measure latency delta, memory footprint, and accuracy on 50-priority prompts.
- Variant C (Redwood low-cost profile): include prefix caching trials for repeated patient-context prompts.

Deliverables:
- Latency CSV + token-cost breakdown by route and model variant
- Quality report (precision/recall proxies) on the 50-priority sample set
- Short executive one-pager with recommended next steps

Pricing (POC estimate):
- Estimated infra & execution fee for 2-day POC: $1,200–$2,500 (depending on peak concurrency). This covers reserved test slots, monitoring, and a short runbook. Formal quote to follow if you move to dedicated commit.

Operational asks from HealthBridge:
- Confirm sanitized sample availability (Jordan)
- Share a short list of up to 3 latency-sensitive endpoints (path names or short descriptions) we should prioritize for tracing

I’ll provision the test sheet and share access shortly: smoke_test_matrix.xlsx (we will upload a working copy to the drive). Camila will lead the run.
